project_type: Frontend-only single-page portfolio website (React 18 SPA, no backend/router).
build_system: Vite 5.4 with @vitejs/plugin-react 4.7. PostCSS (postcss.config.js) runs Tailwind 3.4 + autoprefixer. vite.config.js is the default react() plugin only. node_modules is already installed; baseline build is green (~143 kB JS, 5 kB CSS). A prior dist/ exists and is regenerated by build.
test_framework: NONE installed. The design explicitly defers adding a test runner. Pure logic in src/lib/ is written to be unit-testable later but is not unit-tested in this phase.
build_command: npm run build  (vite build; must exit 0)
test_command: No unit tests. Verification = `npm run build` exiting 0, plus `npm run dev` / `npm run preview` smoke checks (visual + keyboard interaction, and prefers-reduced-motion forced on).
verification_instructions: 1) Run `npm install` ONLY if node_modules is missing (it is present now). 2) Run `npm run build` and confirm exit 0 with no PostCSS/Tailwind 'class does not exist' errors. 3) After the 3D hero exists, confirm the build output lists a SEPARATE code-split JS chunk for the Three.js bundle (React.lazy dynamic import). 4) Run `npm run dev` (or `npm run preview`) and smoke-check: sections render from data, no broken images, no console errors, mobile + desktop widths, and prefers-reduced-motion disables infinite animations + telemetry ticking and renders StaticHudHero.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is build output (gitignored, regenerated by `npm run build`); do not hand-edit. No other generated/checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: No new runtime dependencies may be added (stack is locked to the installed versions). No external .glb/3D model assets, no HDR environments, no @react-three/postprocessing (not installed). No remote image services and no local image file paths — placeholders must be CSS gradients / inline SVG so the site builds and runs fully offline. Keep <React.StrictMode> in main.jsx; R3F 8 is StrictMode-safe, so all effects/intervals/listeners MUST clean up (dev double-invoke). Fonts load via index.html <link preconnect> + stylesheet, NEVER a CSS @import.
contribution_requirements: No README/AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist in the repo. The authoritative spec is .agents/tasks/design.md (§1–§6) and the ordered plan at .agents/tasks/plan.md. Follow the design's exact values (color hex, keyframes, reducer contracts, validation rules, tier thresholds). Commit locally on the working branch per feature; never push.
key_patterns: Single hud Tailwind color group: all utilities read *-hud-* (e.g. text-hud-mid, bg-hud-void, border-hud-line); the hi/mid/dim text ramp is folded into the hud group (text-hud-hi/-mid/-dim) — there is NO separate `text` color group. cyanSoft/amberSoft are NOT Tailwind tokens; they appear only as raw hex in boxShadow/backgroundImage/@layer components. Components read ALL content from src/data/portfolio.js — no content strings hardcoded in JSX. image:null renders a gradient/SVG placeholder with alt="". Pure logic (telemetry reducer, contact validation, device tier) lives in src/lib/ with injectable params (e.g. rng) and no DOM access. Decorative HUD layers (canvas, crosshair, grid, scanlines, telemetry, backdrop) are aria-hidden + pointer-events-none. Semantic landmarks: <header> nav, <main> with <section id aria-labelledby>, <footer>; each section heading is an <h2>. Framer Motion reveals and the telemetry interval are gated by useReducedMotion. The 3D drone is a decorative background layer; hero text/telemetry is plain DOM so it paints instantly and stays accessible.
